chunks: To (communicate) to your heart that you may be a warner

key_terms.الْمُنْذِرِينَ: The warners (those who convey the message of impending consequence)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the heart in receiving the message of the Quran for the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tajalli* (divine manifestation) upon the Prophet's heart, distinguishing his spiritual receptivity as the locus of prophetic authority. It connects the internalization of revelation with the external duty of *Tanzir* (warning), reflecting the dual role of the Prophet as both recipient and transmitter of divine truth.
